name: renderer
body: Renderer: executes standard Go html/template layouts (the standard-library engine) with the registry's minimal function map (v1: `media`). Sections render bottom-up: each section instance is executed through its own `layout.html.tmpl`, deepest first, and each parent receives every child section as a list of trusted HTML, one element per child instance (e.g. `{{ range .blocks }}{{ . }}{{ end }}`); this holds at every depth and for top-level slide sections, so a slide layout receives rendered section HTML rather than data maps. A section template used as a field type stays data-only (typed values, never HTML). Other pre-rendered content: the body and `text` fields are safe HTML; other fields are typed values (number/date formatted per `_format`, boolean, enum, list, image/link URLs). Builds and passes the reserved context (template-context, item-context) — `deck` with the deck-wide title/author/date/properties, `slide` with the derived string position label `number` (number + letter for a vertical slide) and the integer `total`, and `item` with the current instance's `index`/`number`/`count`/`first`/`last`/`section`/`template`/`parent` (nil/absent at slide level) — into the slide layout and into every section instance's execution, at every composition depth; this context is data, not a helper. Layout execute errors become file:line-qualified templates errors. Applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode passed through from `navigation`), vertical stacks, anchors, notes.
